SELECT
  "Fraud Reports by Amount Lost" AS row_label,
  REPLACE(TRIM(column1), ',', '')::BIGINT AS reports_count,
  CASE
    WHEN "Fraud Reports by Amount Lost" IN ('$1 - $100', '$101 - $200', '$201 - $300', '$301 - $400', '$401 - $500') THEN 'numerator_in_1_500'
    ELSE 'outside_1_500'
  END AS range_group
FROM "2024_CSN_Fraud_Reports_by_Amount_Lost"
WHERE "Fraud Reports by Amount Lost" IN (
  'Number of Fraud Reports',
  'Reports with $ Loss',
  '$1 - $100', '$101 - $200', '$201 - $300', '$301 - $400', '$401 - $500',
  '$501 - $600', '$601 - $700', '$701 - $800', '$801 - $900', '$901 - $1,000',
  '$1,001 - $2,000', '$2,001 - $3,000', '$3,001 - $4,000', '$4,001 - $5,000',
  '$5,001 - $6,000', '$6,001 - $7,000', '$7,001 - $8,000', '$8,001 - $9,000',
  '$9,001 - $10,000', 'More than $10,000'
)
ORDER BY range_group, reports_count

SELECT "Fraud Reports by Amount Lost" AS row_label, TRANSLATE(TRIM(column1), ',', '')::BIGINT AS reports_count, CASE WHEN "Fraud Reports by Amount Lost" IN ('$1 - $100', '$101 - $200', '$201 - $300', '$301 - $400', '$401 - $500') THEN 'numerator_in_1_500' ELSE 'outside_1_500' END AS range_group FROM "2024_CSN_Fraud_Reports_by_Amount_Lost" WHERE "Fraud Reports by Amount Lost" IN ( 'Number of Fraud Reports', 'Reports with $ Loss', '$1 - $100', '$101 - $200', '$201 - $300', '$301 - $400', '$401 - $500', '$501 - $600', '$601 - $700', '$701 - $800', '$801 - $900', '$901 - $1,000', '$1,001 - $2,000', '$2,001 - $3,000', '$3,001 - $4,000', '$4,001 - $5,000', '$5,001 - $6,000', '$6,001 - $7,000', '$7,001 - $8,000', '$8,001 - $9,000', '$9,001 - $10,000', 'More than $10,000' ) ORDER BY range_group, reports_count

WITH parsed AS ( SELECT "Fraud Reports by Amount Lost" AS row_label, TRANSLATE(TRIM(column1), ',', '')::BIGINT AS reports FROM "2024_CSN_Fraud_Reports_by_Amount_Lost" WHERE column1 IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(TRANSLATE(TRIM(column1), ',', '') AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL ), num AS ( SELECT SUM(reports) AS numerator FROM parsed WHERE row_label IN ('$1 - $100', '$101 - $200', '$201 - $300', '$301 - $400', '$401 - $500') ), den AS ( SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN row_label = 'Number of Fraud Reports' THEN reports END) AS denominator, MAX(CASE WHEN row_label = 'Reports with $ Loss' THEN reports END) AS reports_with_loss FROM parsed ) SELECT n.numerator AS numerator_1_500, d.denominator AS denominator_all_reports, CASE WHEN d.denominator > 0 AND n.numerator <= d.denominator THEN 'valid' ELSE 'invalid' END AS num_le_den_check, ROUND(n.numerator::DOUBLE / d.denominator, 6) AS ratio_raw, ROUND(n.numerator::DOUBLE / d.denominator, 3) AS ratio_rounded_3dp, d.reports_with_loss AS reports_with_loss, d.denominator - d.reports_with_loss AS reports_no_loss FROM num n, den d
